book.name: Sinale
book.title: Qapiya wei Xuk wei Sinaleyeiw o

content: Paulus aluw Banabas la neil xoulek eivek Aikoniam

Eivek beyeeng nayak Aikoniam, Paulus me Banabas wong ambei ingwei luw mi wong o, me la eivek xomek qekueing ama wei xel Yudayeiw o. Nanghei inyon eno luw neil xoulek wo nimza om xel ngenong wei Yudayeiw me xel amba eno wongis.
Ekom xel Yudayeiw wei mi pesek en embei se bongis eno zeim xel amba laleind lek me xel laleind wo nilul wou xel wei wongis o.
Om Paulus aluw Banabas dei enden ka eivek inyon, de luw se yaleeng en neileing qayeeng wei Tambiy Ngandoung xe lalei xeiles o, om Anutu wong ninkanzek wou luw me luw wong dee wei lulvako leimalei yo.
Xel xomaxoneing wei beyeeng ngandoung on dembuma la yuw, om xel valu la is Yudayeiw, de valu la is sinaleyeiw.
Woyom xel amba me Yudayeiw is xel xe gyovaxa tup qayeeng wouma bei bo nol wou Paulus aluw Banabas me banex luw a mey angya qakous.
Ekom luw woulek inyon, om luw pek me la eivek tembuing danghei wei Likonia eivek beyeeng nayak yuw wei Listra me Debi, me beyeeng beyeeng wei toundei paviy yo,
nanghei inyon eno luw lox me la neil Xoulek Nimza no.
Paulus aluw Banabas la neil xoulek eivek Listra me Debi
Eivek Listra inyon tambiy ti mindei, eno vaxa bezomb gyeik ingwei umbek o, om moxo se mi ghavineeng.
Moxo mi ngo ingwei Paulus mi luk on, Paulus doma wou e, me yeimbei moxo wongis me e teyeimbei bo nimza lek.
Om Paulus taxe la bei, “Nale lek vaxam!” Woyom moux moxo nale ghey de tetyeik me la.
Xomaxoneing qendu ngandoung on yei vati wei Paulus wong on, om xel taxe la eivek Likonia vyend bei, “Anutu lam axone wou xey nambei xomaxoneing!”
Banabas, xel taxe e lei bei anutu Sus, me Paulus xel taxe bei anutu Helmes, en nambei e mi la tax en lukeing.

Xomek lalo wei anutu Sus eno toundei paviy tete mya wei beyeeng ngandoung on, om lumuki wei xomek lalo yon me xel xomaxoneing on qou manghaxo moux me palawa me la tete mya wei beyeeng ngandoung on en xel embei besei xound wou luw.
Ekom sinale Banabas aluw Paulus ngo tine, luw lex luw xe teimb dom veimyend me la senghoing eivek xel qendu yon me taxe bei:

“Xam moux, xam ghe di wong tine en va? Uw ne xomaxoneing is me xomaxoneing nambei xam. Uw a di qou Xoulek Nimza me na lam wou xam, om uw a neil wou xam bei xam pekwi xow veil lul nilul tine de ghe na wou Anutu mapieing, e tiwei toung tyoung aluw tembuing me mamileeng me lulul sapa wei toundei eivek o.
Eivek bouk wei takwei yo eno moxo wong xel tembuing dalus on betiwou xel venaxow xe sakwaing.

Ekom e venaxow se xupek en xomaxoneing bei xel se boulek e. Ma. Taxombouk eno moxo mi talex e xe kwa nimza wou xam. Moxo mi wong luing lam anghei tyoung eivek xam xe lulul wei xam ghe ev eivek xuk o, me moxo wong yaeing ngenong wou xam is me wong xam laleimim wo xeilala.”
Luw neil qayeeng tine wou xel, ekom xel wo nikanzek bei besei xound wou luw. Om luw neil nikanzek bei xel se besei xound wou luw.
Woyom Yudayeiw valu lam anghei Antiok me Aikoniam me zeim xel qendu yon laleind lek. Om xel nex Paulus angya qakous me tetei ela myayaing veil beyeeng ngandoung on, de xel embeik nge moxo mey.
Ekom ka xel betiyeing qekuma vivekwou e, de moxo qandi lek me lox me la eivek beyeeng ngandoung on. De yanyeing eno Paulus aluw Banabas la Debi.
Luw loum Antiok eivek Siria
Luw neil Xoulek Nimza eivek beyeeng ngandoung tiyon me qou xel ngenong wo betiyeing. Woyom luw lox me la Listra, Aikoniam me Antiok,

me luw byexaxoun xel betiyeing laleind me neil qayeeng nikanzek wou xel bei, “Xam a mi mendei embo nikanzek eivek wongeingis me zonghek. Tyek xey a na eivek nimaying ngenong atax en kandek nana eivek tete lalei wei Anutu yo”.
Paulus aluw Banabas beyal xel gyovaxa eivek kongrikesin titi. De luw vambu yaeing me zeimemend, me toung xel la wou Tambiy Ngandoung, inyon eti yeiw wei wongis Tambiy Ngandoung o.
Ka luw la senghoing eivek tembuing danghei wei Pisidia, me la tyip eivek tembuing danghei wei Pampilia,
me luw la neil xoulek eivek beyeeng nayak Pelga, dekakom luw la xo wei beyeeng Atalia nei.
Nanghei Atalia luw la eivek sip me lox me la Antiok, inyon beyeeng wei xel wong luw la eivek lalei xeiles wei Anutu yo en xuk wei luw wong ema gweimbeeng ne yo.
Luw lam tyip inyon eno luw qeku xel kongrikesin lekti me wo qayeeng dalus wei Anutu wong wou luw me e tax xomek mya wei wongeingis eno wou xel amba yo.
De luw dei inyon enden ka is xel betiyeing.
